preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Input consists of lines of text, where the first line is T (number of test cases), followed by 2*N lines per test case (N and A_i values).

preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.splitlines()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 10**5
preconditions.description: T is a positive integer within the constraint 1 ≤ T ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer within the constraint 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(A) <= 10**9 for A in [stdin.splitlines()[2 + 2*i].split() for i in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each A_i is a non-negative integer within the constraint 0 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A_list) == N for N, A_list in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)], [stdin.splitlines()[2 + 2*i].split() for i in range(T)]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of A_i values matches N.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['-1'] or (output_line.isdigit() and int(output_line) >= 0) for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' (impossible) or a non-negative integer (minimum total length of roads).

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == T for output_lines in [stdout.splitlines()[1 + i*2:1 + i*2 + 1] for i in range(T)])
postconditions.description: There is exactly one output line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((N == 1) == (output_line == '0') for N, output_line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If N = 1, the output is '0' (no roads needed).

postconditions.expression: all((N > 1 and all(A == 0 for A in A_list)) == (output_line == '-1') for N, A_list, output_line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)], [stdin.splitlines()[2 + 2*i].split() for i in range(T)], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If N > 1 and all A_i = 0, the output is '-1' (no valid roads can be built).

postconditions.expression: all((N > 1 and any(A != 0 for A in A_list)) and (output_line != '-1') == (any((A_x & A_y & L) == L for A_x in A_list for A_y in A_list for L in range(1, max(A_x, A_y) + 1)) for A_list in [stdin.splitlines()[2 + 2*i].split() for i in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: If N > 1 and at least one A_i ≠ 0, the output is not '-1' only if there exists at least one valid road (L > 0) between some pair of cities.

postconditions.expression: all((N > 1 and all(A == 0 for A in A_list)) or (N == 1) or (output_line != '-1' and int(output_line) == min_total_length) for N, A_list, output_line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)], [stdin.splitlines()[2 + 2*i].split() for i in range(T)], stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: For each test case where output is not '-1', the output is the minimum total length of roads to connect all cities, where the total length is computed as the sum of L values for roads built between cities such that (A_x & A_y & L) == L, and the graph is connected.

postconditions.expression: all((N > 1 and all(A == 0 for A in A_list)) or (N == 1) or (output_line != '-1' and int(output_line) == sum(L_values)) for N, A_list, output_line in zip([int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 2*i]) for i in range(T)], [stdin.splitlines()[2 + 2*i].split() for i in range(T)], stdout.splitlines())))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of L values for a spanning tree of cities where each edge (X, Y) satisfies (A_X & A_Y & L) == L, and the sum is minimized.
